source: example — per-point flooding records for historical rain events (illustrative). Complaint logs, inspection sheets and 993 records can all be flattened into this shape.
notes: One row = one fact about one flood point (fp_id, client id such as ADM-62) in one event (event_id, e.g. 2024-04). flooded true/false is the ground truth for verification; depth_m (max observed), duration_min, units (pumps actually sent), first_arrival_min, drain_min are optional; stage (alerted/staged/reported/verified/dispatched/arrived/pumping/dry/closed/reviewed) with at (ISO time) records a lifecycle timestamp; source names the origin (complaint / inspection / 993 / contractor / satellite). Several rows per point-event are merged. Place the real file at exchange/episodes.json, POST it to /api/feed/episodes, or set [feeds.episodes].url.
